title: AS2: interface declarations and implements keyword
description: Implement AS2 interface declarations in the compiler (packages/core/src/as2/). The parser may already handle 'interface Foo { function bar():Void; }' and 'class Baz implements Foo'. Verify: (1) interface declarations compile to a no-op (interfaces are compile-time only in AS2/AVM1 — no runtime bytecode needed). (2) 'implements Foo' on a class is parsed and validated but generates no bytecode. (3) Add 6 tests in __tests__/interfaces.test.ts: interface compiles without error, implements keyword parsed, class still works, interface method signatures don't emit bytecode.
